verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a live, key-gated REST Cloud API for launching and managing instances, and cloud-init can run workloads at launch, so an agent can provision and start work without the console. The evidence does not show API-level teardown or monitoring, and there is no official CLI or MCP server; the community-built CLI/MCP is third-party and earns no credit. Monitoring evidence is console-based (Usage page) or limited to Kubernetes/Slurm dashboards. missing for 10: explicitly documented API terminate/teardown endpoint, programmatic instance/GPU health monitoring via API, official CLI or MCP server, independent hands-on corroboration of a full agent-driven lifecycle.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can provision a GPU, monitor it, run a workload, and tear it down end to end through documented APIs, CLI, or MCP without a human in the console

citations.quote: You can also launch instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
If you're launching your instance with the Lambda Cloud API, you can add launch-time configuration instructions using cloud-init
